snippet.title: Scales of Silence - Couch Party Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Scales of Silence is a couch party game for the living room. Grab a controller, pick your snake and start shrinking your friends.

- Length is your health bar. Collisions shrink you. Too short, and the next hit's the last.
- Four battle modes. Score chases, timed brawls, last-snake-standing royales, and endless classic runs.
- A roster of snakes with their own stats and habits worth learning.
- 8 controller support, keyboard split into 4 schemes (WASD, IJKL, Arrows and Numpad).
- Co-op story campaign

Free demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4602160/Scales_of_Silence_Demo/
